about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: I build maintainable, performant Angular applications and lead teams to deliver product-focused solutions.
about.p1: I've spent the last nine years diving deep into Angular, where I've found my passion for creating user interfaces that aren't just visually appealing but also easy to use and efficient for developers.
about.p2Intro: Throughout my career, I've worked on a range of projects for well-known clients like
about.p2Outro: while pursuing my studies in the German line of the Computer Science Faculty at Babeș-Bolyai University.
about.p3: While I'm comfortable working independently, I've come to appreciate the power of teamwork. Now, I'm focused on creating a collaborative atmosphere where everyone can succeed and push boundaries together.

humanBehind.title: The human behind the code
humanBehind.p1: Outside of projects, my favorite time is the time I spend with my wife, my friends and the people I love. I recharge at the gym, on the tennis court or at the helm of a sailboat, and whenever we travel, the camera always comes along.
humanBehind.p2: I love to cook, I'm fascinated by history and all things automotive, and I read a lot, mostly business and self-improvement books; every now and then I unwind with a game on my PC.
humanBehind.p3: I'm a sociable person and I love animals: at home we share our space with Leo, our cat, and Ginger, our little dog. Same person online and offline: open, involved and easy to work with.

clientFounder.quote: We were lucky to have Alex jumping in one of our core projects as Front-End Software Engineer and perform at full speed. […] We were able to deliver on time the custom software application we signed up for. After this first successfully delivered project, we went on collaborating with Alex, as he is truly perseverant, responsible team player with strong technical and project management skills.

reportedColleague.quote: His organization, focus, and dedication have been key to our team’s success on the project. He has this rare ability to see both the big picture and the finer details. […] He makes sure everyone on the team feels valued and heard, setting clear goals, realistic timelines, and offering feedback that genuinely helps us improve.

fullstackColleague.quote: Alex and I had a very good collaboration while working together on a project for a big automotive company from Germany, where he was the Frontend Lead. Alex was always willing to offer support when needed and gave good feedback during code reviews. He was always up to date with the latest Angular best practices and made sure those improvements found their way into our project.

angularColleague.quote: I had a great experience working with Alex while collaborating on a project for a German automotive brand. He is a skilled Angular developer, reliable teammate, and always ready to help when needed. I really appreciated his professional attitude, attention to detail, and the way he approached frontend development challenges.

backendColleague.quote: I had the pleasure of working alongside Alex in the same development team, where I handled backend development, and he took charge of the front end. From the very beginning, it was clear that Alex is not just a front-end developer but a true craftsman who excels at transforming complex requirements into intuitive and user-friendly designs.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1p1: RSA SOFT S.R.L. ("RSA SOFT", "we", "us") is the data controller for the personal data processed through this website. You can reach us at alex.rusu@rsasoft.ro.
privacyPolicy.s1p2: Full company registration details are listed on our Legal Notice page.
privacyPolicy.s2p1: We collect two categories of data:
privacyPolicy.s2li1: Data you give us directly: your name, email, phone number, company, and any message you send us when you book a call, submit a form, or contact us by email, WhatsApp, Telegram, LinkedIn, or XING.
privacyPolicy.s2li2: Data collected automatically, only if you consent to analytics cookies: pages visited, approximate location derived from your IP address, browser and device type, and referral source.
privacyPolicy.s3Title: 3. Why we process your data and on what legal basis
privacyPolicy.s3li1: To respond to your inquiry and discuss our custom software development services, based on your request and the steps needed to enter into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li2: To understand how visitors use our website and improve it, based on your consent given through the cookie banner (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li3: To keep our website secure and functioning correctly, based on our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li4: To comply with legal obligations, such as accounting and tax record-keeping (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s4Title: 4. Who we share your data with
privacyPolicy.s4p1: We use a small number of service providers acting as data processors on our behalf: Google (Analytics, Calendar, and YouTube embeds) and our hosting provider. These providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, in which case we rely on the safeguards they provide, such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacyPolicy.s4p2: We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
privacyPolicy.s5Title: 5. How long we keep your data
privacyPolicy.s5p1: We keep inquiry and contact data for as long as needed to handle your request, and afterwards only if required by law (for example, accounting records must be kept for the period set by Romanian tax law).
privacyPolicy.s5p2: Analytics data is retained according to Google Analytics' standard retention settings, and only if you have consented to analytics cookies.
privacyPolicy.s6p1: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s6li1: Access the personal data we hold about you
privacyPolicy.s6li4: Restrict how we process your data
privacyPolicy.s6li5: Receive your data in a portable format
privacyPolicy.s6li6: Object to processing based on our legitimate interest
privacyPolicy.s6li7: Withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal
privacyPolicy.s6p2: You can also lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP) at www.dataprotection.ro, or with the supervisory authority in your own EU country of residence.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.s1p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and, when you agree, help us understand how visitors use our site.
cookiePolicy.s2p1: Google Analytics' tag loads on every visit, but it only sets cookies and stores identifiable data once you click "Accept All" through our banner. If you click "Reject Non-Essential" instead, no cookie is set and Google only receives anonymous, cookie-free signals used for aggregated statistics (Google's Consent Mode). Necessary cookies, which store your preferences, are always active.
cookiePolicy.necessary1: rsa-soft-cookie-consent (localStorage) — remembers your cookie choice, so we don't ask again on every visit.
cookiePolicy.necessary2: rsa-soft-lang (localStorage) — remembers your language preference (English, German, or Romanian).
cookiePolicy.analytics1: _ga, _ga_*, _gid (Google Analytics) — help us understand aggregate site usage. Set by Google only after you click "Accept All"; if you click "Reject Non-Essential", no cookie is set and only anonymous, non-identifying signals are received.
cookiePolicy.embeds1: YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) — our video testimonials use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode, which does not set cookies until you press play.
cookiePolicy.embeds2: Google Calendar — our booking widget is a Google Calendar iframe, which may set cookies from Google needed for the booking flow to work.
cookiePolicy.s3p1: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies at any time using the "Manage Cookie Settings" button above, the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer, or your browser's own cookie controls.
cookiePolicy.s4p1: Questions about this policy? Email us at

services.title: Two ways to work with us
services.intro: Either we build the application, or a senior developer joins your team. If you're not sure which fits, we'll sort it out on the first call.
services.projectTitle: We build the application for you
services.projectText: We take on a new application, or an existing one that needs modernising. The work is done by Alex, RSA SOFT employees and freelance specialists, depending on what the project needs.
services.projectFit: Enterprise web applications, internal reporting tools, moving an old frontend to modern Angular.
services.projectBilling: Depends on the project. Usually time & material, at an hourly rate.
services.projectStart: A scoping call, then a written offer and a signed agreement before any work starts.
services.teamText: A senior developer joins your team, works with your processes and tools, and stays as long as the project needs.
services.teamSpeed: So far, every placement has taken at most 48 hours from the first call.
services.teamBilling: Hourly: the developer's rate plus our fixed margin of €10/hour, both shown separately.
services.teamVetting: An introductory interview, a language test in English and German, and a reference check.

projects.title: Projects we've worked on
projects.intro: We can't name our clients, so we describe them by industry. Alex's projects, with dates and the full stack, are on a dedicated page.

featured.title: Security vulnerability management application
featured.text: The application protects more than 40,000 of the client’s employees. Alex led its entire frontend in a Scrum team of 6, for three and a half years.
featured.point1: Migrated the application from VanillaJS to Angular, then through every major version from 15 to 21.
featured.point2: Built the interface on the client's design system, with lazy-loaded components.
featured.point3: Integrated SAML authentication and NgRx for state management.
featured.point4: Mentored the junior developers on the team.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: For staffing, yes: we broker the collaboration, but our margin is fixed and visible, €10/hour on top of the developer's rate. Custom software we deliver with our own team.
faq.a2: So far, every placement has taken at most 48 hours from the first call. For projects, the start date goes into the written offer.
faq.a3: Each one goes through an introductory interview, a language test in English and German, and a reference check.
faq.q4: What's the legal basis for working together?
faq.a4: Every collaboration is covered by a written agreement, signed before work starts.
faq.q5: How long does the developer stay on the team?
faq.a5: As long as the project needs. The longest collaboration so far lasted three and a half years, on the same automotive project.
faq.q6: What language do you work in?
faq.a6: English and German. The language test in our vetting covers both.

welcome.p2: My job on this call isn't to sell you. It's to understand what you actually need and tell you plainly if RSA SOFT is a fit or not.
welcome.p3: Below you'll find how the call works, the questions people usually ask before booking, and the proof behind what we do. If something's missing, ask it directly on the call.
